title: Wholesome Grilled Turkish Danmuji Solo-Dinner
description: A resinous and flaky solo-dinner Turkish dish featuring danmuji, en-croute, and diabetic-friendly ingredients, grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut the danmuji into 2 equal pieces.
Place a piece of danmuji in the center of the pastry square.
Brush the edges of the pastry with olive oil.
Fold the pastry over the danmuji to form a square shape, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with olive oil and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and chopped parsley.
Place the danmuji en-croute on the preheated binchotan grill and cook for 12-15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and puffed.
Remove the danmuji from the grill and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the danmuji hot, garnished with chopped parsley and a drizzle of lemon juice and honey.
Serve with a side of chopped dill and grated feta cheese if desired.
